options.label: Via Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage (default)
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and proceed to Kandy, stopping en route to visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Upon reaching Kandy, explore the city with a guided city tour. Later, check in and relax at the hotel.

options.label: Direct to Kandy (no stops)
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and transfer directly to Kandy. Check in and relax at the hotel — city tour to follow the next morning.

options.label: Scenic Route + City Tour (default)
options.description: Travel to Kandy, stopping en route at scenic points of interest along the way. Upon arrival, explore Kandy with a guided city tour before checking in and relaxing at the hotel.

options.label: Via a Tea Factory Stop
options.description: Travel to Kandy, stopping en route to visit a working tea factory and plantation. Upon arrival, check in and relax at the hotel.

options.label: Kandy City Tour (default)
options.description: Full day at leisure in Kandy — visit the Temple of the Tooth Relic, the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, and explore the local markets around the lake.

options.label: Kandy → Sigiriya Day Trip
options.description: Full day excursion to Sigiriya — climb the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress and visit the nearby Dambulla Cave Temple, returning to Kandy in the evening.

options.label: Breakfast & Airport Transfer (default)
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.

options.label: Shopping Stop Before Airport
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel. En route to the airport, stop for last-minute souvenir shopping before your departure flight.

options.label: Direct to Bentota (default)
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and proceed directly to Bentota. Check in and relax at the resort.

options.label: Via Galle Fort
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and proceed to Bentota via a stop at the historic Galle Fort. Check in and relax at the resort.

options.label: Coastal Drive + Beach Leisure (default)
options.description: Proceed to Bentota through scenic countryside and coastal landscapes. Upon arrival, enjoy leisure time at Bentota Beach and relax at the resort.

options.label: Via Turtle Hatchery
options.description: Proceed to Bentota, stopping en route to visit a sea turtle hatchery. Upon arrival, check in and relax at the resort.

options.label: Madu River & Turtle Centre (default)
options.description: Explore Bentota — take part in a Madu River boat ride, visit the Turtle Centre and try the Fish Spa, or spend the day at leisure with optional water sports.

options.label: Water Sports Day
options.description: Full day at leisure in Bentota with optional water sports — jet skiing, banana boat rides, and windsurfing available at the beach.

options.label: Breakfast & Airport Transfer (default)
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.

options.label: Morning Spa Before Departure
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel, followed by a relaxing spa treatment. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight.

options.label: Direct to Hotel (default)
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and transfer directly to your hotel in Colombo.

options.label: Arrival + Evening City Tour
options.description: Arrive at Colombo International Airport. Meet & greet by our representative and transfer to your hotel, followed by a short evening city tour.

options.label: City Tour + Shopping (default)
options.description: Drive to Colombo, enjoying a city tour covering Independence Square, Galle Face Green, Gangaramaya Temple and the Old Parliament. Finish the day with some shopping.

options.label: Direct to Hotel, No Sightseeing
options.description: Drive to Colombo and check in directly at the hotel — a free evening to rest before departure.

options.label: Leisure & Shopping (default)
options.description: Full day at leisure in Colombo, with time for shopping and optional excursions.

options.label: Museum & Gem Gallery Tour
options.description: Full day exploring Colombo's National Museum and a guided visit to a gem gallery, with free time for shopping in the afternoon.

options.label: Breakfast & Airport Transfer (default)
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Later, transfer to the airport in time for your departure flight — leaving Sri Lanka with beautiful memories.

options.label: Last-Minute City Stop
options.description: Breakfast at the hotel. En route to the airport, a brief stop at a local market for last-minute shopping before your departure flight.
